visualCharacteristics.structure: compact data table inside a white dashboard widget
visualCharacteristics.headers: first header cell empty/transparent; Immediate Action header dark red #710100 with white text; Near Term Action header amber #f7b500 with dark orange text; small (10-11px) centered header text, tall header row
visualCharacteristics.rows: first column labels left-aligned on light grey #eee, 13-14px; numeric cells centered on darker grey #ddd, 12px; 2px white gaps between cells
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fleet Alerts status matrix of open items by action urgency

contentPattern.pattern: status matrix: row labels x action-urgency columns
contentPattern.structure: first row is the header: an empty first cell, then one cell per urgency column (e.g. Immediate Action, Near Term Action); each following row is a row label (e.g. Open Orders) followed by one numeric count per urgency column. Always 3 columns
